label: Sheets & ribbons
title: Pasta roller + cutters
does: Roll sheets for lasagne and ravioli; cut fettuccine or spaghetti with the matching cutter. Filling and sealing ravioli stays a hand job.
limit: Optional KSMPRA is listed for KitchenAid tilt-head mixers including KSM195. Filling and cooking remain separate. Dry classic rollers and brush out debris; do not immerse.

label: Tubes & twists
title: Gourmet Pasta Press
does: Press-specific dough becomes spaghetti, bucatini, fusilli, rigatoni or macaroni through the matching discs. The wire trims the length.
limit: Use the press’s recipe and disc-specific speeds. The rolled-pasta dough and roller speed chart are not universal substitutes.

label: Grind & stuff
title: Grinder + sausage stuffer
does: Grind very cold cubed meat, then use compatible stuffer plates and tubes to fill casings. Some kits include tubes; others don’t.
limit: A stuffer needs a grinder. Neither cooks nor cures meat. Chill metal equipment, keep meat at 4°C or below and cook thoroughly. Use the pusher, never fingers.

label: Slaw & grated cheese
title: Fresh Prep Slicer/Shredder
does: Matching drums slice firm produce or shred vegetables and suitable cheese for slaw, hash browns and pizza prep.
limit: Not a purée maker or general chopping blade. Official Fresh Prep guidance specifies speed 4; use its pusher and your exact model’s blade chart.

label: Vegetable ribbons
title: Spiralizer
does: Spiralize firm produce; peel, core or slice with the appropriate blade combination. Trim ends and secure the produce first.
limit: Blade sets differ. Follow the size range and blade-specific speeds; not every soft fruit or oversized potato will work.

label: Juice & sauce
title: Juicers + fruit strainer
does: A citrus juicer handles halves; a Juice & Sauce attachment separates appropriate produce. A grinder-mounted strainer makes smooth fruit or vegetable purée.
limit: Different tools, not one interchangeable attachment. KSMFVSP requires KSMFGA, not legacy FGA. Remove large pits. Juicing is not pasteurizing or preserving.

label: Flour from grain
title: Grain mill
does: Mill dry, low-moisture, non-oily grains such as wheat or rice. The freshest flour starts with grain suited to the mill.
limit: Not for oily nuts, seeds, coffee or nut butter. Official guidance: after the equivalent of 10 cups flour, allow 45 minutes cooldown; follow stricter limits. Raw flour is still raw.

label: Snow, not ice cream
title: Shave Ice attachment
does: Shave pre-frozen moulded pucks into fine or coarse ice; add syrups, fruit or other prepared toppings afterward.
limit: Freeze filled moulds 12–24 hours first, per manual. It does not freeze liquid or churn ice cream. Sugar and alcohol change whether a puck sets properly.

label: Continuous prep
title: Food Processor attachment
does: With the relevant discs, slice, shred and julienne into a receiving bowl. KSM2FPA includes an 8 mm dicing kit.
limit: Package contents differ. This disc-based attachment is not a standalone S-blade processor for pesto or hummus. Check local availability and included parts.
